author: OpenAI
description:
We’re bringing GPT-Image-2.6 to Codex and the API. In the API, the 2.6 versions of Flare and Sunburst generate images 50% faster than before.

Use Flare for a quick first pass on a poster or product shot. At low image quality, it can generate an image in as little as six seconds. When you need details to stay consistent across edits, use Sunburst at medium or high quality. Try changing a product’s backdrop while keeping its shape and texture, or bring a mascot to life as a looping GIF.

http://openai.com/index/introducing-images-2-6/
title: GPT-Image-2.6: Faster image generation with Flare and Sunburst

author: OpenAI
description:
Messi wanted this empty room to feel a little more like him, but wasn’t sure where to start. So he asked ChatGPT for some ideas.

Try it yourself: “Reimagine this room in my style. Surprise me.”
title: Messi asks ChatGPT to reimagine his room

author: OpenAI
description:
Marketers shouldn’t have to wait for a new dashboard to understand how a campaign is performing.

In an early pilot with OpenAI, Figma is building shared context that helps marketers ask how campaigns are landing and whether they’re converting customers. Teams can get useful insights sooner, without waiting for someone to build a dashboard or metric.

“OpenAI has unlocked the ability to deliver self-serve analytics across Figma,” says Sharath Chandra, who leads Data Engineering.

Watch Sharath explain the workflow.
title: How Figma Is Building Self-Serve Analytics with OpenAI
